dcp.name: No residential DCP; only rural/industrial/special-purpose DCPs (DCP-2 to DCP-16)

gaps: No town/village residential DCP chapter. DCP-5 General Rural Zones (1 Dec 1992) and DCP-6 Rural Small Holdings may carry rural dwelling setbacks but could not be read (fetch of https://www.cabonne.nsw.gov.au/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/planning-and-development/local-environment-plan/dcp-5-general-rural-zones.pdf was blocked by a permission timeout).
notes: Council page lists 12 adopted DCPs (none residential; DCP-15 Relocatable and Transportable Homes 29 May 2024 is closest, not read for setbacks). Part 3D Inland Code of the Codes SEPP applies to this LGA (named in cl 3D.1(4)); see fallback/nsw-inland-code.json. Not a DCP control.
